control_plane: GKE 1.35.8-gke.1225000, two replicas, Postgres 16 in cluster
notes: Bench nodes: two tuned and two stock n2d-standard-4 in us-west1-b, and the same in us-central1-a, so region cannot stand in for tuning.
Tuned nodes run one thread per core with the second core isolated and benchmarks pinned; stock nodes are the machine type as GCE ships it, SMT on, nothing isolated.
The gate_soft and gate_strict evaluations ran at the same time on the same tuned nodes.
Binaries were built by Cloud Build at the commit each run's spec records as its revision.
